text: **ScanFocus** and **MomentSeg** were accepted to **ECCV 2026** — ScanFocus combines global spatio-temporal scanning with local refinement; MomentSeg unifies temporal grounding and segmentation through moment-centric sampling.

**SimpleSearch-VL** technical report released — a multimodal agentic deep-search framework that combines adaptive rollouts, evidence verification, and self-summarized visits for efficient search and reasoning.
**VideoSEG-O3** was accepted to **ICML 2026** — a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that actively explores temporal intervals and keyframes for reasoning video object segmentation.
**DeRVOS** was accepted to **CVPR 2026** — decoupling consistent trajectory generation from multimodal understanding for referring video object segmentation.
**DRL** was accepted to **Pattern Recognition** — an end-to-end UAV self-localization method using efficient heterogeneous spatial feature interaction.
**GC3VG** was accepted to **TCSVT 2025** — extending C3VG to generalized multi-task visual grounding with region alignment and coarse-to-fine consistency constraints.

**InstanceVG** was accepted to **TPAMI 2025** — instance-aware joint learning for generalized visual grounding, with consistent point, box, and mask predictions across no-target, single-target, and multi-target scenarios.

**PropVG** and **DeRIS** were accepted to **ICCV 2025** — PropVG introduces end-to-end proposal-driven grounding with multi-granularity discrimination; DeRIS decouples perception and cognition through loopback synergy for referring image segmentation.
**C3VG** was accepted to **AAAI 2025** as an **oral presentation** — joint referring localization and segmentation with coarse-to-fine consistency constraints.
**SimVG** was accepted to **NeurIPS 2024** — a simple visual grounding framework with decoupled multimodal fusion and synchronized teacher–student distillation.
**DenseUAV** was accepted to **TIP 2023** — a real-world dataset and benchmark for vision-based UAV self-positioning in low-altitude urban environments.
**FSRA** was accepted to **TCSVT 2021** — Transformer-based feature segmentation and region alignment for cross-view UAV geo-localization.
